title: papaver comptum
intro: Papaver comptum, commonly known as the Small Poppy, is a flowering plant species belonging to the poppy family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate pain due to its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Papaver comptum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation, improving sleep, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. While more research is needed, Papaver comptum has been traditionally used to support sleep quality, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation.
